outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic-style diagram illustrating camera exposure time vs illumination overhead with percentages, not a data plot averaging replicate measurements; individual data points are not applicable.
Line plot of photobleaching decay curves with shaded s.e.m.; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Scatter plot of ΔROS vs exposure time with error bars per condition; scatter plots are exempt as points themselves are the data.
Each panel shows individual migration tracks per single cell (color-coded), so individual data are already displayed rather than an average summary.
Bar chart of migration speed (mean±s.e.m.) has individual cell data points (dots) overlaid on each bar.
Panel F consists of micrographs (Mitotracker, Paxillin, merge) and does not present averaged quantitative data requiring individual points.
Panel G is a micrograph time-series, not a quantitative average plot.
Panel H is a micrograph time-series, not a quantitative average plot.
Line plot of normalized cell area over time with mean±s.e.m.; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Line plot of normalized mitochondrial area over time with mean±s.e.m.; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
